property_summary: For any valid transfer call that completes without reverting, the returned boolean must be true; the buggy mutant returns false for all such calls, violating this universal invariant.

For any valid call to transfer that completes without reverting, the return value equals the result of the last external call in the loop (which is always true due to require(_s)); the mutant always returns false, breaking this invariant.

For any admissible input where the external call in the loop succeeds, the return value of transfer must equal the success flag of that call (true); the mutant always returns false regardless, violating this invariant.
For any admissible transfer call that completes without reverting, the return value must be true; the mutant returns false for all such calls, violating this invariant.
For any admissible input where transfer completes without reverting, the return value must be true; the buggy mutant returns false, violating this invariant.
For any admissible input that does not cause a revert, transfer must return true; the mutant returns false, violating this invariant.
For any input that satisfies the requirements, P.transfer returns true; M.transfer returns false under the same conditions, violating the invariant that the return value must be true.
